positions.name: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
SBI Cards and Payment Services Limited
Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited
Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corporation Limited
Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited
Power Grid Corporation of India Limited

config:
asset_classes:
- equity
equity:
  market: IN
  factor: lowvol
  neutral: neutral
  weighting: dollar
  tier: 2
  shortable: true
universe_filters:
- type: HistoryFilter
  params:
    min_days: 252
- type: DataIntegrityFilter
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: adv_usd
    min_value: 3000000.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: raw_close
    min_value: 20.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: mcap_usd
    min_value: 200000000.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: TradedDaysFilter
  params:
    min_share: 0.9
    lookback: 63
- type: OneClassPerIssuer
- type: ShortableFilter
  params:
    mode: passthrough
vol_normalizer:
  type: Identity
signals:
- type: CrossSectionalSignal
  weight: 1.0
  params:
    indicator:
      type: PanelCharacteristic
      params:
        panel: vol252
        sign: -1
    ranker:
      type: GroupNeutralRank
      params:
        inner:
          type: PercentileRank
          params:
            min_names: 5
        min_group_size: 5
        min_names: 40
    position_function:
      type: GroupNeutralQuantilePortfolio
      params:
        long_pct: 0.3
        short_pct: 0.3
        weighting: equal
        max_weight: 0.05
        cap_method: redistribute
        min_group_size: 5
        group_weight: names
asset_allocator:
  type: Identity
model_gearing:
  type: XSVolTarget
  params:
    target_vol: 0.1
    vol_lookback: 126
    leverage_cap: 5.0
    buffer: 0.1
cost_model:
  type: EquityCosts
  params:
    market: IN
rebalance: monthly
position_smoothing: 21
smoothing_method: sma
group_level: sector
